complianceBadges.label: EU only
complianceBadges.detail: Every document and every model call is processed on servers inside the EU.

complianceBadges.label: 100% GDPR
complianceBadges.detail: Fully compliant with all European Union data protection requirements.

complianceBadges.label: AES encrypted
complianceBadges.detail: Data is stored with AES encryption and protected in transit.

complianceBadges.label: No model training
complianceBadges.detail: Your data is never used to train AI models.

video.title: Scibly — The learning platform for modern teams

hero.productAlt: Scibly AI notebook: creating a course from your documents

notebook.label: AI Notebook
notebook.description: The notebook isn’t a chat that just generates on its own. You work hand in hand with the AI while a live preview of the course grows beside you.

points.label: You steer, it drafts
points.text: Scibly asks targeted questions and proposes structure, scenes, and matching infographics.

points.label: Whole workspaces
points.text: Connect Notion, Confluence, and more, not just single documents.

points.label: Never out of date
points.text: When a source changes, scibly flags the affected lessons and suggests updates.

courseBuilder.label: Course Builder
courseBuilder.description: We’re AI native, but you’re never just a spectator. The Course Builder is a full collaborative editor.

points.label: Edit together
points.text: Your team works on one course. Scenes, tone, exercises, and order stay editable.

points.label: Build with blocks
points.text: Hints, flashcards, characters, and question types like multiple choice.

points.label: You keep control
points.text: With AI or with each other, every creative call stays yours.

gamification.label: Practice
gamification.description: A course only works when it sticks.

points.label: Mixed practice
points.text: Quizzes, cloze, and matching take turns as learners work through a lesson.

points.label: Visible progress
points.text: Streaks, combo points, and a skill tree that shows how far they got.

points.label: Playful, not shallow
points.text: Everything is grounded in the content you approved.

gamification.guideTip: IT never asks for your password in chat. When it feels urgent, pause.

gamification.optWrong: Send the password so work isn’t blocked
gamification.optCorrect: Refuse and report it to IT
